<!--
Use this template for non-normative improvements: tooling, CI, documentation,
developer experience. To propose new terminology, use the "Terminology
proposal" template. To propose a new or changed standard, use the "Standard
proposal" template.
-->

## Problem

What problem does this solve? Who has it?

## Proposed solution

Describe what you'd like to happen.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you've thought about, and why you prefer this one.

## Scope check

- [ ] This is **not** a change to normative content (specs, standards,
      terminology) — those use the dedicated templates.
- [ ] I have checked [`docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`](../../docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) and
      this proposal is consistent with it (or I explain the conflict below).

## Additional context

Links, prior art, examples from other standards projects.
